Ward (github.com/MuhammadMurtuzaHussain/ward, public MIT, local checkout at `/Users/haider/Desktop/Hacktoberfest 26/ward`) is a child-owned cyberbullying guardian for the DEV Hacktoberfest Week 4 challenge (deadline 31 Oct 11:59 PM PDT, about 06:59 GMT 1 Nov). It's a pnpm monorepo: TS engine in `packages/engine` (node --test), web app in `apps/web` (React, English + Urdu i18n in `apps/web/src/i18n/en.ts` and `ur.ts`), Discord bot in `apps/discord`, eval in `eval/`, Ward Lite classifier in `train/`, Electron `desktop/`, Capacitor `mobile/`. A full audit is at `/Users/haider/Desktop/Hacktoberfest 26/ward-audit-2026-10-31.md`; many items were fixed this afternoon (see `git log`). Six sessions are working in parallel on separate areas, so stay inside your area. Project rules: commit and push each verified change straight to main (no PRs), with the attribution line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`; never commit `eval/data` or secrets; commit messages are short plain-English sentences like the existing log. Write code that matches the surrounding style. Docs must never claim more than the code does.

Task:
Your area: the app's reading of the child's own voice. Audit section 2, items #3, #4 and #7 (read them in `ward-audit-2026-10-31.md`; check against current code first, since the engine changed today).

Setup: other sessions share this checkout, so work in your own worktree: `git -C ward fetch && git -C ward worktree add "../ward-wt-reader-safety" -b reader-safety origin/main`, run `pnpm install` and `node apps/web/scripts/copy-ort.mjs` there, and work only in that folder.

1. **First-person distress (#3).** A separate `selfDistress` signal on the child's own messages from a first-person lexicon (English, Roman Urdu, Hinglish, Bangla; guard against "dying of laughter"-style false hits). The result shows a care card plus HelpNow and skips "Was I mean?". The lesson grader checks for disclosure before grading. Add the case to `docs/HARMS.md` and eval cases. Mark Roman Urdu/Hinglish/Bangla entries as needing native-speaker review.
2. **Quoting for help (#4), in the app.** A frame rule for first-person recipients ("told me", "mujhe kaha", "আমাকে বলেছে") plus a distress or help-seeking signal: show "someone may need support" and don't count the sender as hostile. Don't match a bare "someone said" or quote marks. `apps/discord/src/frame.ts` already has a Discord version: reuse or move it into the engine rather than duplicating. Add a quoting rule to the Gemma prompt in `ollama.ts`.
3. **Verdict hold (#7).** While Ward Lite/Gemma are still reading, show a neutral "Ward is reading this closely" heading instead of calm; show bullying/urgent immediately; warm Ward Lite when Check opens; announce verdict changes via a live region.

Out of scope: Ward Lite retraining, Me/vault/store screens, eval/ benchmark, build/CI/mobile config. Every change needs tests, with all strings in en.ts and ur.ts. Run `pnpm test` and the web build. Then rebase onto origin/main, re-run tests and push to main (on rejection, fetch, rebase, retest, push). Push each of the three pieces as it's done, not all at the end. Finish with a short report: what landed (commit hashes), what's left, and anything that needs the owner's decision or a native speaker.

### The five problems that matter most

1. **The safety net has holes exactly where children are most at risk.**
   - On a phone, a lone threat or sextortion demand that only Ward Lite catches is marked "unsure". It never reaches "urgent", the Coach or the report.
   - A calm result has no "this still feels wrong" path to help.
   - Ward never notices the child's own distress.
   - A child quoting abuse to ask for help is read as the bully.
2. **What reaches children is not what was tested.**
   - CI-built APKs and installers ship without ONNX Runtime, so Ward Lite silently doesn't run.
   - The APK won't install on 32-bit budget phones.
   - Every download link and the "Give Ward" QR code lead to a 404, because no release has ever been cut.
   - Saving a chat longer than about 200 messages to the vault fails silently.
3. **Some public claims run ahead of the code.**
   - "Never leaves the device" is false when a phone is paired with a family computer.
   - The report's green "Unchanged since it was saved" can be faked with one line of JavaScript.
   - "Helplines for the child's country" shows Pakistan's numbers to a child in Dubai.
   - The headline scorecard compares a model trained on the test datasets with one that never saw them.
4. **The campaign would outrun your own safeguarding rules.**
   - SAFEGUARDING.md says crisis paths must not be "turned on more widely until the professional review is done".
   - There is no reviewer, no safeguarding lead and no contact inbox.
   - The app currently tells children to post their corrections, optionally with real chat text, to a public GitHub issue.
5. **Discord server mode breaks a public promise.** SAFEGUARDING.md says Ward will never let an adult "receive alerts". Server mode alerts moderators, and it can tell a child who discloses abuse to "edit or delete" their message.

---

## 2. Fix first

These are the high-severity findings, ordered by harm to children first. Overlapping findings from different auditors are merged.

| # | Finding | Why it matters | The fix | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Unconfirmed dangers on phones lose the strong help.** `analyze.ts:54-61` backs a Ward Lite-only flag only with nearby word-list hits or a distressed reply. Otherwise `:155` marks it unsure and `:157` drops it, so there is no urgent level, no Coach (calm results get "practise", `Result.tsx:156`), no Take It Down (`images={false}`, `Result.tsx:114`) and no report incident (`report.ts:94`). 11 of the phone's 18 dangerous red-team catches have no word-list hit. | A child blackmailed for images, or urged to self-harm, in a 1:1 DM who freezes and doesn't reply is the highest-stakes case. The in-progress UI does show "I'm not sure about one message" plus helplines, so this is a gap, not silence. | In `backedUp()`, treat a severity-3 flag in a chat with only one other person as backed. Let a second look move severity 3 to "unsure", never to 0 (`analyze.ts:151`). When `unsureDanger` is set, show the Coach button and compute imageRisk. Add unconfirmed severity-3 incidents to the report with `confirmed: false`. Don't record such a check as plain "calm" in history (`run.ts:48/84`, `Vault.tsx:127`). | S to M |
| 2 | **A missed message has no path to help.** The correction control only appears on flagged messages (`Result.tsx:412`). Saying "worse" or "threat" changes nothing (`corrections.ts:1-3`). A calm result offers "Practise spotting it". On Home, the only helpline door is the 14-17 safety plan (`Home.tsx:93`). | Phone recall on the red-team set is 53% for hurtful and 47% for dangerous messages. An 8 to 13 year old Ward failed sees "trust that feeling and tell someone" with no "who". | Add a quiet "It still feels wrong" button on calm results that opens Coach or HelpNow. Add a help door on Home for every age. Add "Ward missed this" on every message from someone else. When a child marks threat, self-harm, sexual or exposure, show HelpNow (raising help, never lowering the verdict). | S |
| 3 | **Ward never notices the child's own distress.** Own messages are excluded (`analyze.ts:157`). Every self-harm pack entry is second person ("kill yourself"). If a model flags "i want to die", the only route is "Was I mean?" (`Result.tsx:89, 158-164`). The lesson grader has no disclosure branch (`grade.ts:13-17`). | Bullied children are at higher risk of self-harm. This also contradicts PLAN.md:44-46 ("if Ward sees signs of self-harm ... it shows crisis lines straight away"). | Add a separate first-person distress lexicon in all four languages, reviewed by native speakers, as its own `selfDistress` signal. Show a care card plus HelpNow and skip "Was I mean?". Check lesson answers before grading. Add a reviewed "heavy feelings" Bounce back lesson. Add the case to HARMS.md and to both eval sets, guarding against "dying of laughter". | M |
| 4 | **A child quoting abuse to ask for help is read as the bully.** The phone flags 12 of 14 quote-for-help messages (REDTEAM.md:141). Pack hits are never re-read. The main Gemma prompt has no quoting rule (`ollama.ts:75`). There is no "reporting" kind in training. In Discord, the child is DMed "edit or delete it" (`main.ts:284-291`). | Punishing help-seeking undoes the whole intervention. | Add a frame rule for first-person recipients only ("told me", "mujhe kaha", "আমাকে বলেছে") plus a distress or help-seeking signal. When it matches, show "someone may need support" and don't count the sender as hostile. Skip the Discord nudge. Add a quoting kind with near-miss negatives to training. Don't match a bare "someone said" or quotation marks, which bullies could use to slip past. | M |
| 5 | **Helplines default to Pakistan for any unrecognised time zone.** `help.ts:70` falls through to "PK", and every `America/*` zone gets the US. The child's choice isn't saved (`HelpNow.tsx:11`). The school kit prints the same guess (`Kit.tsx:140`). README.md:50 promises "helplines for the child's country". | A child in Dubai in danger reads "call 15". This is the highest-stakes number on screen, and diaspora children are your language audience. | Make unknown zones "OTHER": show Find A Helpline first and "call your local emergency number", with no digit. Map US zones explicitly. Save the picked region in the profile. Let the kit printer choose. Add UAE and Saudi Arabia with cited sources. Add a test that Asia/Dubai never yields PK. | S |
| 6 | **Discord server mode alerts adults, against the policy.** SAFEGUARDING.md:263-264 and HARMS.md:47 forbid alerts. Server mode posts the message and "From: @user" to #ward-alerts. I reproduced it: "someone told me to kys and I can't stop thinking about it" and "@Bilal stop telling Sara to kys" both alert, nudge the author and DM the mentioned person. Neither doc mentions Discord. | It silences disclosures and upstanders, and "Nothing is stored" (`main.ts:8, 209`) leaves out that alert copies persist in Discord. | Make a public decision: remove server mode, or relabel it a moderator tool with its own policy section. Then add disclosure and upstander detection before any nudge, post link and category only for self-harm alerts, post a pinned notice to members, and add tests in three languages. | M |
| 7 | **"This looks okay" shows before the model has read the chat.** `run.ts:42-52` opens the result on word lists alone, which catch 10% of English abuse. Ward Lite loads only then (about 39 MB plus a 27 MB wasm). The h1 has no live region (`Result.tsx:104`). Gemma can also lower a verdict later (`analyze.ts:105-114`). | The child, or a glancing adult, reads "looks okay" and leaves. Screen-reader users never hear the change. | While refining, show "Ward is reading this closely" instead of calm or watch. Show bullying or urgent straight away. Warm Ward Lite when Check opens. Announce changes with `role="status"`. Keep a softened help path if Gemma clears a danger hit. | M |
| 8 | **The app tells children to post corrections, optionally with chat text, to a public GitHub issue.** `en.ts:602` and `ur.ts:609`. The "include the words" box is at `ShareCorrections.tsx:47-53`, and nothing gates it by age (`Result.tsx:361-369`). | It contradicts CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md:28-30. GitHub is 13+ and permanent, and nobody is in place to remove anything. | Rewrite the copy to "Keep this file. If your school joins a Ward pilot, you can give it to your teacher." Hide the button for 8-10 and the text box outside counsellor mode. Add issue templates that warn "never paste a real child's chat". | S |
| 9 | **Unreviewed crisis paths are public, and a kid-facing campaign is planned.** SAFEGUARDING.md:177-179 bars widening crisis paths, the safety plan and "Was I mean?" before review. Those are live in the app now (`App.tsx:125, 129`). Safe-messaging guidance is still "Planned" (:159-160). TikTok is 13+. | A viral push would be an unreviewed population deployment to children that produces no outcome data. | Gate kid-facing install calls to action on a named reviewer (section 5). Put a build flag on the two unreviewed features, or label them as previews in SAFEGUARDING.md. Keep the helplines visible. Notify DRF (weekday hours only, `help.ts:33`) and Madadgaar before launch. | M |
| 10 | **No safeguarding lead, no contact addresses, no legal home.** GOVERNANCE.md:30, 140 and 162. Placeholders in CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md:55-57, SECURITY.md:22 and SAFEGUARDING.md:226-227. Private vulnerability reporting is off (`{"enabled":false}`). Fiscal host and org are undecided (GOVERNANCE.md:258, 269). | Your own rules block pilots, the youth group and any gated feature until this is filled. A concern raised today has nowhere private to go. | Today: create safeguarding@, security@ and conduct@ addresses, fill the placeholders, turn on private reporting, and add "Raise a concern" to the README and app. Over weeks: recruit a lead from a partner organisation, independent of the receiving helpline, with an honorarium. | S now, M later |
| 11 | **Saving a long chat to the vault fails silently.** `vault.ts:31` spreads the whole ciphertext into `String.fromCharCode`, which throws above about 120 KB in V8 (roughly 170 to 270 messages). SaveToVault has no try/catch, and PinPad can lock up (`PinPad.tsx:20-23`). | Real class groups are long. Without a save there is no report, no QR handover and no viewer, and the child isn't told. | Store raw bytes in IndexedDB, or reuse the chunked encoder from `qrTransfer.ts:11-15`, while still reading old rows. Add try/catch with a translated message, and try/finally in PinPad. Add a test with 2,000 messages using fake-indexeddb. | S |
| 12 | **The report "integrity" check is an unkeyed SHA-256.** `report.ts:143-156`. The recipe is published in REPORT.md:51-65, and the viewer shows a green "Unchanged since it was saved" (`ward-viewer.html:225`). REPORT.md:62-63 claims nobody can quietly flip "in danger now". | Caseworkers and police may lean on a green banner that any editor can fake. | Now: make the wording honest everywhere ("matches its own checksum; catches accidental damage, not deliberate edits"). Later: report v3 with a device signature and a Discord server key. Signing proves which install saved the report, never what was said. | S now, M later |
| 13 | **CI-built APKs and installers ship without ONNX Runtime.** `public/ort/` is gitignored, `copy-ort.mjs` is never called, and `vite.config.ts:9-14` deletes Vite's copy. The CI APK has the 37.7 MB model and no wasm. `liteAvailable()` hides the failure. | Every distributed build would read with word lists only, so the README's phone scorecard column would be false for real users. Local builds only work because the folder exists on your machine. | Put the copy inside the `build` script itself or a Vite `buildStart` hook (pnpm 12 skips `prebuild`). Add a `closeBundle` check, an `unzip -l` assert in android.yml, and a smoke check that Ward Lite loads. Show a notice when Lite can't start. | S |
| 14 | **The APK won't install on 32-bit budget phones.** LiteRT-LM ships only arm64 (22 MB) and x86_64 (26 MB) native libraries, with no abiFilters (`build.gradle:55`). Android refuses installs with no matching ABI. The feature that needs them only runs on phones with 5.3 GB+ RAM. | Android Go phones are common where your users are. "Give Ward to a friend" would hand them an APK that fails to install. README.md:46 says "Reads on any phone". | Build two flavours: a default lite APK with no LiteRT-LM (about 34 MB instead of 82 MB, installs anywhere) and an arm64-only Gemma APK. Assert the native-library lists in CI. Test on a real 32-bit phone. | M |
| 15 | **Nothing is downloadable, and signing isn't set up.** There are no tags, no releases and no secrets. The README badges (:12-13) and the Give QR (`giveWard.ts:7`) return 404. The app tells children to compare a fingerprint "on Ward's GitHub releases page" (`en.ts:634`) that doesn't exist. Debug builds use throwaway keys with the same app id. versionCode is fixed at 1. | The campaign would send everyone to a dead link. With allowBackup=false, moving from a debug build to a release means uninstalling, and that wipes the vault. | You create the keystore with two offline backups and add the four secrets. Fix #13 first, check on a real phone, then tag v0.1.0 as a preview. Publish the certificate SHA-256 and SHA256SUMS in the release body. Derive the version from the tag. Add a `.debug` suffix to debug builds. Until then, change the badges to "build from source". | S to M |
| 16 | **Desktop installers are unsigned, and the README's macOS steps are stale.** `desktop.yml:48`. README.md:158-159 says to right-click and Open, which macOS 15 removed. There is no SmartScreen guidance. | Counsellor mode and lab mode target managed school machines, which block unsigned installers. | Now: rewrite the steps ("Open Anyway" in Privacy & Security, an `xattr` fallback, "More info, Run anyway"). Later: Apple Developer ID with hardened runtime and a camera entitlement, plus SignPath for Windows. | S now, M later |
| 17 | **Nothing measures the verdict the child actually sees.** Every eval scores single messages without context (`eval/run.ts:27-33`). Only 3 fixture chats exist. The context rule can confirm Ward Lite false flags in sweary groups and hide lone real threats, and neither effect is measured. | Product changes like the context rule ship untested on the metric that matters. | Build 30 to 40 labelled synthetic chats per language, with lone threats with and without a reply. Add `pnpm eval:chats` with a level confusion matrix and false-urgent and missed-urgent rates per tier. Gate the context rule on a missed-urgent ceiling. | M |
| 18 | **The headline scorecard compares models trained on the test datasets with ones that never saw them, and the Gemma rows are stale.** Ward Lite trains on the train splits of CB1 and roman_urdu_hate_speech. On Bangla, where it trained on other data, it falls to 40% while Gemma E4B leads at 65%. The Gemma rows predate the re-ask fix (`seconds: 0`). E4B is labelled "one message at a time" but runs 20 per batch. README.md:118 contradicts its own table. | Judges read "phone 85% vs Gemma 36% on English" as the architecture's proof. Mostly it shows in-distribution learning. | Rerun E4B and E2B. Mark in-distribution rows. Fix the "about" strings and the README sentences at :101-103 and :118. Add a per-row run date and bootstrap intervals. Point to Bangla as the honest out-of-distribution check. | S |

**The child's own distress.** The child writes "i want to die", "main marna chahti hoon" or
"আমি মরে যেতে চাই" in the chat they check, or in a lesson. Bullied children are at higher risk

  messages for wanting to die or to hurt themselves. It never changes the level, the patterns or

I pushed all three pieces to Ward's main: `570f5f2` (#3), `e547279` (#4) and `a93dabd` (#7). `pnpm test` passes (56 pass, 1 skip: the existing training-data leak check) and the web build passes after each rebase. I also tried each piece in the app.

**What changed**
- **#3, the child's own distress (`570f5f2`):** a new list in `packages/engine/src/distress.ts` reads the child's own messages for wanting to die or to hurt themselves. It covers English, Roman Urdu/Hinglish, Urdu, Hindi and Bangla.
  - It's a separate signal: it doesn't change the level or count anyone as hostile.
  - The result opens with "Something you wrote sounds really heavy" and the helplines. It never says "This looks okay" or "Reading closely" over it, and "Was I mean?" and the practise suggestions are hidden.
  - Lesson write answers are checked first: a disclosure gets care and the helplines, not a grade, and isn't sent to a model.
  - Hyperbole is left out ("dying of laughter", "im dead 💀", "hans hans ke mar gayi"). The softer phrases ("wanna die", "kms") don't count next to a laugh. "He told me to kill myself" counts as a report, not distress.
  - 50 test cases are in `eval/distress/cases.jsonl`, and docs/HARMS.md has a new entry.
- **#4, quoting for help (`e547279`):** the Discord rule moved into `packages/engine/src/frame.ts`; the Discord file now just points to it.
  - A message counts only when it has both a first-person recipient ("told me", "mujhe kaha", "আমাকে বলেছে") and help-seeking or distress.
  - The sender isn't counted as hostile, and the result shows "Someone may need support". If they also sound like they want to die, the helplines show too.
  - A bare "someone said", quotation marks, "you" or "or else" never count.
  - The child's own quote never leads to "Was I mean?". Gemma's prompt has the quoting rule.
- **#7, the verdict hold (`a93dabd`):** the "I'm reading this closely" heading, the screen-reader announcement and the fix for Gemma lowering a danger were already on main. What was missing was starting Ward Lite early: it now loads when Check opens, unless Gemma will read the chat instead.
